name: tripmap
description: Turn a trip in your macOS Photos library into a transparent PNG route map

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:@resvg/resvg-js --outfile=dist/cli.js --banner:js="import{createRequire as __createRequire}from'module';const require=__createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node -e "require('fs').chmodSync('dist/cli.js', 0o755)"
